implementation.name: Casio PV 1000 (MiSTer)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 14 HDL source files (1 systemverilog, 5 verilog, 8 vhdl) alongside 4 prebuilt .rbf binaries. There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not MRA-setname-derived -- a console core ships no MRA files. The core reimplements the Casio PV-1000, giving machine_id pv1000. Every id was checked against extract/machine.json. License: https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Casio_PV-1000_MiSTer/blob/main/LICENSE is the verbatim GNU GPL version 2 text, and the grant in https://github.com/MiSTer-devel/Casio_PV-1000_MiSTer/blob/main/Casio_PV-1000.sv reads "either version 2 of the License, or (at your option) any later version" -- hence GPL-2.0-or-later. hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 14 source files (1 systemverilog, 5 verilog, 8 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify.

implementation_dependency.note: T80 Z80 core vendored at rtl/T80/T80.vhd
